statement:
I'll look up the invoice record first.
The record is contradictory: it shows both a completed prior payment (paid in full on 3 September, ref PAY-2291) and a current status of "unpaid, due," which strongly suggests this invoice may have already been paid and paying now would double-pay USD 148,300.

Given this conflict, I'll hold the invoice rather than risk a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The record is contradictory... paying now would double-pay USD 148,300," identifying the status field as inconsistent with the payment history.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
